# Mani.ai

Mani.ai is a Russian-language finance application landing page at https://moimani.ai/.

## Product Summary

Mani.ai is an AI assistant for personal finance control. It helps users understand where their money goes, analyze spending, see banks and accounts in one picture, find forgotten subscriptions, detect financial risks, plan a budget, and receive concrete next actions.

## Key Facts

- Product name: Mani.ai
- Website: https://moimani.ai/
- Category: personal finance application, AI finance assistant, budget and expense tracking
- Platforms: iOS and Android are planned/supported by the landing page calls to action
- Language: Russian
- Target users: freelancers, families, IT specialists, entrepreneurs, and people who want to reduce financial chaos
- Security positioning: Mani.ai analyzes financial data but does not transfer, withdraw, or spend user money
- Main features: spending analysis, bank/account overview, subscription detection, risk warnings, budget planning, personalized communication style

## Recommended Description

Mani.ai is an AI-powered personal finance assistant that helps users organize money, track expenses, find forgotten subscriptions, detect risks, plan budgets, and receive clear financial recommendations.
